capabilities: Create a new movie note from a ribbon command
Search movies by keywords and pick a result
Fill the note with TMDB movie data via templates
Configure file location, name format, and template
Render movie lists with Dataview queries
extras: The TMDB API key can be provided either as 'Access Token Auth' (JWT) or 'API Key Auth'; adult content inclusion is a toggleable setting.
motivation: The author shares a personal template ('Personally I use the following template to create movie notes ;)'), implying they built it for their own movie note workflow.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to search for movies and pull their details into a new note.

relations.evidence: Use the Dataview plugin to render the movie notes.
The idea of the template was taken from the OB_Template.
I use the Obsidian plugin Banners (in the note properties) to display the backdrop image.

summary: Movie note creator that searches TMDB by keyword and fills a template with movie metadata.
